declared_in_advance.no_enlargement_beyond_pairs: if no single and no pair changes the criterion, the result is reported as robustness to one and two misses and the family stops there
declared_in_advance.this_is_not_a_probability: counts of hypothetical corrections are not likelihoods. No claim is made about how often this annotation actually misses

family.insertion_rule: one insertion per retained detection that the augmented configuration leaves unmatched, placed at that detection's own position with that detection's class. No geometry is invented: the hypothesis is exactly 'this detection is right and the annotation missed the object'
family.reachability: the inserted object is reachable by every retained detection of the same class within the declared 2 metre rule, recomputed, not assigned. That includes base detections, so an insertion can help the base as easily as the addition
family.sizes: singles first; pairs only if no single changes the criterion, declared here in advance

justified_by: the 0.1.0 result, not by a search for a flip. The deletion family found a breakdown number of 1, so the opposite direction is the next thing a validation lead needs and is the direction this benchmark is known to fail in

outcomes_kept_distinct.fall_to_zero: the delta reaches zero without changing sign
outcomes_kept_distinct.note: three different events, never reported as one

question: if the annotation missed an object that a retained detection actually found, how many such misses would it take to change the improvement criterion, and in which direction does the conventional answer err
recomputation: both matchings recomputed from scratch for every case
recorded_outcomes: the weighted delta for every case
the exact range over the family
the smallest number of insertions that changes the criterion
whether the change is toward supported or away from it
scope: one cohort, two previously exposed development frames, one supplied benchmark interpretation, one insertion rule. Not a label accuracy assessment, not a physical reference, not evidence of decision value
separate_family: this is a second family with its own declaration. Its results are reported as its own and are never merged into the 0.1.0 deletion family
what_an_insertion_means: a hypothetical missed label correction. It is not an observed object, a physical reading, a human admission or a claim that the detection is correct. It is the smallest well defined way to ask what a missed annotation would do
why_this_direction_matters: a spurious label and a missed label are not symmetric under this loss. A missed label turns a correct detection into a counted false positive, so if the added detector finds objects the annotation lacks, the conventional answer understates it. Which way the annotation actually fails is not established here and is not assumed
